title: Neferhotep I
summary: King of Egypt's Dynasty 13, who CFAH says served in the administration of Senusret III.
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 13, who CFAH says served in the administration of Senusret III. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: 1576 BC ±2.5 years. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Neferhotep I and Senusret III Synchronism"
